name: ccgram-notify
description: Codex-first Telegram notify and remote-control workflow built on the CCGram bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Telegram notify and control for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds a Codex-first notify workflow to the CCGram bridge: normal local codex launches stay native, interactive blockers reach Telegram, and Telegram-opened sessions remain fully interactive.
